en.t: Before long, the moon came out.

units.source_text: 源氏公子开了柴门，向外眺望，

en.t: Prince Genji opened the brushwood gate and gazed outside,

units.source_text: 但见附近浪潮袭击之处，痕迹显然，并且还有余波来来去去。

en.t: and saw that nearby, where the waves had struck, the marks were plain, while the afterswells still came and went.

units.source_text: 附近一带村民之中，知情达理而懂得过去未来、天变原因的人，一个也没有。

en.t: Among the villagers in the area, there was not a single person wise enough to understand affairs, the past and future, or the causes of heavenly changes.

units.source_text: 只有一群无知无识的渔夫，

en.t: There was only a group of ignorant fishermen,

units.source_text: 知道这里是尊贵之人的住处，

en.t: who knew that this was the dwelling of a noble person,

units.source_text: 大家聚集在垣外，说些听不懂的土话，

en.t: and they all gathered outside the fence, speaking some local dialect that could not be understood,

units.source_text: 模样甚是奇特，然而也不便驱散。

en.t: looking very strange, though it would not have been proper to drive them away.
Then the fishermen were heard saying:

units.source_text: “这风若再不息，海啸就涌上来，

en.t: "If this wind still does not stop, the tidal wave will come surging in,

units.source_text: 这一带地方将完全淹没呢！

en.t: and this whole area will be completely flooded!

units.source_text: 全靠菩萨保佑，功德无量！”

en.t: It is all thanks to the Bodhisattva's protection; the merit is immeasurable!"

units.source_text: 如果认为源氏公子听了渔夫这番话提心吊胆，那样说未免太愚蠢了。

en.t: If one were to think that Prince Genji became frightened on hearing these words from the fishermen, that would be far too foolish a thing to say.
